description: Guest link opening: opening a guest invitation link returns the meeting view or a failure.

cases.inputs: invitationId: I1; linkToken: <valid link token of I1>.
preconditions: Invitation I1 for nguyen@example.com is not revoked.
Its meeting "Họp giao ban" is Published, planned 09:00-10:00.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success with GuestInvitationView { invitationId I1, meeting { id, title "Họp giao ban", status "Published", planned start/end }, maskedEmail "ng***@example.com" }.

preconditions: Invitation whose meeting is InProgress and not revoked.

cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidInvitation) (MSG371); the invitation store is not read.

preconditions: Invitation I1 was revoked by the Secretary.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidInvitation) (MSG371): the reason is not revealed.

preconditions: Invitation I1 is not revoked but its meeting is Ended.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidInvitation) (MSG371): an invitation stops working when the meeting is no longer Published or InProgress.

cases.inputs: invitationId: <random Guid>; linkToken: <token computed for that Guid>.
preconditions: No invitation with the supplied id exists.

cases.log: Error log "Could not read guest invitation {InvitationId}."
preconditions: The invitation store fails with a persistence error while reading.
Invitation for the email abc@example.com (at-sign at index 3) is open.
cases.return: maskedEmail = "a***@example.com" (one leading character when the local part is 3 characters or fewer).

preconditions: Invitation for the email abcd@example.com (at-sign at index 4) is open.
cases.return: maskedEmail = "ab***@example.com" (two leading characters from a 4-character local part).

precondition: Meeting and guest invitation rows seeded.
